files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: calculate
tool_schemas.description: Evaluates a simple arithmetic expression string and returns the computed numeric result. It accepts numbers, + - * / operators, parentheses, and whitespace. It refuses expressions that are missing, not parseable, or contain unsupported characters/operators (including malformed parentheses or invalid syntax).

expression.description: The mathematical expression to calculate, such as '2 + 2'. The expression can contain numbers, operators (+, -, *, /), parentheses, and spaces.

tool_schemas.name: cancel_pending_order
tool_schemas.description: Cancels an order that is still pending and returns the updated order details reflecting the cancellation. It refuses requests when the order_id is missing/invalid, the order cannot be found, the order is not in a pending state (for example already processed or delivered), or the provided reason is not one of the allowed values. It also refuses cancellation when the order is already cancelled or otherwise not eligible to be cancelled due to its current state.

order_id.description: The order id, such as '#W0000000'. Be careful there is a '#' symbol at the beginning of the order id.

reason.description: The reason for cancellation, which should be either 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake'.

tool_schemas.name: exchange_delivered_order_items
tool_schemas.description: Exchanges specified items from a delivered order for replacement items of the same product type and returns the updated order details including any price difference handled via the provided payment method. It refuses requests when the order_id is missing/invalid, the order cannot be found, the order is not delivered, or an exchange/return has already been performed for that delivered order. It also refuses when item_ids and new_item_ids are missing, have different lengths, reference items not in the order, map to a different product type than the originals, or when the payment_method_id is missing/invalid or not usable for settling the difference.

order_id.description: The order id, such as '#W0000000'. Be careful there is a '#' symbol at the beginning of the order id.

item_ids.description: The item ids to be exchanged, each such as '1008292230'. There could be duplicate items in the list.

new_item_ids.description: The item ids to be exchanged for, each such as '1008292230'. There could be duplicate items in the list. Each new item id should match the item id in the same position and be of the same product.

payment_method_id.description: The payment method id to pay or receive refund for the item price difference, such as 'gift_card_0000000' or 'credit_card_0000000'. These can be looked up from the user or order details.

tool_schemas.name: find_user_id_by_email
tool_schemas.description: Find user id by email. If the user is not found, the function will return an error message.

email.description: The email of the user, such as 'something@example.com'.

tool_schemas.name: find_user_id_by_name_zip
tool_schemas.description: Find user id by first name, last name, and zip code. If the user is not found, the function will return an error message. By default, find user id by email, and only call this function if the user is not found by email or cannot remember email.

first_name.description: The first name of the customer, such as 'John'.

last_name.description: The last name of the customer, such as 'Doe'.

zip.description: The zip code of the customer, such as '12345'.

tool_schemas.name: get_order_details
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves an order’s current status and full order details for the given order_id. It refuses requests when order_id is missing/invalid or when no order exists for that id. It may also refuse access if the order is not associated with the customer context implied by the request.

order_id.description: The order id, such as '#W0000000'. Be careful there is a '#' symbol at the beginning of the order id.

tool_schemas.name: get_product_details
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves product-level inventory and detail information for the given product_id. It refuses requests when product_id is missing/invalid or when the product cannot be found. It also refuses when an item id is provided in place of a product id and no matching product exists.

product_id.description: The product id, such as '6086499569'. Be careful the product id is different from the item id.

tool_schemas.name: get_user_details
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a user profile and associated order summary/details for the given user_id. It refuses requests when user_id is missing/invalid or when the user cannot be found. It may also refuse access if the requested user is not within the permitted customer scope for the caller.

tool_schemas.name: list_all_product_types
tool_schemas.description: Lists available product types (name and product_id) with optional pagination, returning up to the requested limit and a cursor when more results are available. It refuses requests when limit is outside the allowed range or when the cursor is invalid/expired. It also refuses requests containing unexpected parameters beyond limit and cursor.

limit.description: Maximum number of product types to return (there are only 50 total).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to continue listing product types from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: modify_pending_order_address
tool_schemas.description: Updates the shipping address on a pending order and returns the updated order details. It refuses requests when the order_id is missing/invalid, the order cannot be found, or the order is not pending (including already processed, delivered, or cancelled). It also refuses when required address fields are missing or invalid (for example empty address lines, city/state/country, or zip).

order_id.description: The order id, such as '#W0000000'. Be careful there is a '#' symbol at the beginning of the order id.

address1.description: The first line of the address, such as '123 Main St'.

address2.description: The second line of the address, such as 'Apt 1' or ''.

tool_schemas.name: modify_pending_order_items
tool_schemas.description: Replaces specified items on a pending order with new items of the same product type and returns the updated order details including any price difference handled via the provided payment method. It refuses requests when the order_id is missing/invalid, the order cannot be found, the order is not pending, or the order’s items have already been modified once. It also refuses when item_ids and new_item_ids are missing, have different lengths, reference items not in the order, map to a different product type than the originals, or when the payment_method_id is missing/invalid or not usable for settling the difference.

order_id.description: The order id, such as '#W0000000'. Be careful there is a '#' symbol at the beginning of the order id.

item_ids.description: The item ids to be modified, each such as '1008292230'. There could be duplicate items in the list.

new_item_ids.description: The item ids to be modified for, each such as '1008292230'. There could be duplicate items in the list. Each new item id should match the item id in the same position and be of the same product.

payment_method_id.description: The payment method id to pay or receive refund for the item price difference, such as 'gift_card_0000000' or 'credit_card_0000000'. These can be looked up from the user or order details.

tool_schemas.name: modify_pending_order_payment
tool_schemas.description: Changes the payment method used for a pending order and returns the updated order details. It refuses requests when the order_id is missing/invalid, the order cannot be found, or the order is not pending (including already processed, delivered, or cancelled). It also refuses when payment_method_id is missing/invalid or not available for the order/customer.

order_id.description: The order id, such as '#W0000000'. Be careful there is a '#' symbol at the beginning of the order id.

payment_method_id.description: The payment method id to pay or receive refund for the item price difference, such as 'gift_card_0000000' or 'credit_card_0000000'. These can be looked up from the user or order details.

tool_schemas.name: modify_user_address
tool_schemas.description: Updates the specified user’s default shipping address and returns the user record with the new address applied. It refuses requests where the user_id does not match an existing user or where any required address fields are missing or empty. It also refuses updates that don’t represent a complete address (for example missing city/state/country/zip) or that are not authorized for that user.

address1.description: The first line of the address, such as '123 Main St'.

address2.description: The second line of the address, such as 'Apt 1' or ''.

tool_schemas.name: return_delivered_order_items
tool_schemas.description: Creates a return request for the specified delivered order and item_ids, updates the order state to “return requested,” and returns the updated order/return details. It refuses requests when the order_id is unknown, when the order is not in a delivered state, or when item_ids contains items that are not part of the order or are not eligible to be returned. It also refuses the request when the payment_method_id is not available for that order/user or cannot be used for the required refund/charge adjustment.

order_id.description: The order id, such as '#W0000000'. Be careful there is a '#' symbol at the beginning of the order id.

item_ids.description: The item ids to be returned, each such as '1008292230'. There could be duplicate items in the list.

payment_method_id.description: The payment method id to pay or receive refund for the item price difference, such as 'gift_card_0000000' or 'credit_card_0000000'. These can be looked up from the user or order details.

tool_schemas.name: think
tool_schemas.description: Records an internal note for this session and returns an acknowledgment; it does not fetch data or modify any customer, order, or inventory state. It refuses requests that omit the thought text or provide a non-string/empty thought. It may also refuse oversized thoughts that exceed allowed length limits.

tool_schemas.name: transfer_to_human_agents
tool_schemas.description: Hands the conversation off to a human agent and returns a confirmation that includes the provided issue summary. It refuses requests without a summary or with an empty/non-string summary. It may also refuse transfers when a handoff is not available for the current conversation context.

summary.description: A summary of the user's issue.

metadata.name: Crescent Commerce Care Console
metadata.description: A customer support backend that lets agents quickly find users, orders, and products, update customer and pending order details, and process cancellations, returns, and exchanges with escalation to human agents when needed.
